curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with Nevada's mandatory liability insurance and proof of insurance, then the minimum coverage amounts, the NV LIVE program, and the fines and penalties for a lapse.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per insurance rule; a contrast card for the injury limits versus the property limit.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on minimum coverage and lapse penalties.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach how crashes reach the DMV, when you must file an SR-one and who files it, how fault and liability are decided, penalties for uninsured or unreported crashes, and the SR-twenty-two.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each reporting rule; contrast cards for investigated versus uninvestigated crashes and the SR-one versus the SR-twenty-two.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on crash reporting and SR forms.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the first duties at a crash, moving a fender bender aside, exchanging information, and what to do after hitting an unattended vehicle or property.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each crash-scene duty; a contrast card for an injury crash versus a fender bender.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what to do at a crash scene.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain that a license is a privilege, what goes on the record and for how long, how demerit points are counted, the suspension threshold, traffic school, and revocation for major offenses.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each record rule; contrast cards for three versus seven years and for suspension versus revocation.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on demerit points, traffic school and revocation.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the demerit point values for common violations and speeding, the partial nature of the list, the online driver record, and the ban on false or misused licenses.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each point value; contrast cards for reckless versus careless driving and for speeding bands.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz matching violations to point values.
